newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Autrey lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Autrey lowered to hold.

text.p: Mexico's Abaco brokerage said on Tuesday it downgraded Grupo Casa Autrey to a hold rating from buy.

"As a result of comments made by company management and our market expectations for the pharmaceutical market in the short term, we are less optimistic about Autrey's short-term performance," analyst Luis Miranda wrote.
Miranda said the brokerage adjusted its 1997 earnings per share estimate to 1.039 pesos from 1.050 pesos, because of a weak first quarter.

"As a result of the slow recovery and evolution of the other categories, we estimate an operating profit decrease of approximately 17.5 percent from Q1 1996 to Q1 1997," Miranda wrote, also referring to Autrey's discounts and promotions. He said the stock appears to be discounting a poor first quarter report, but may be overreacting.
Autrey's shares rose 0.22 peso in trading on Tuesday to close at 13 pesos each.
